description: Financial Risk & Opportunity Matrix – Custom Power BI Visual Objective This custom Power BI visual is designed to assess financial health across departments or investments by plotting risk versus opportunity in a 2x2 matrix. It supports scenario analysis, strategic decision-making, and prioritization of actions based on financial impact and potential gains. The visual includes filtering, license validation, and CSV export features to empower business users with rich insights. Key Elements of the Visual Logic User Inputs The visual accepts multiple inputs from the Power BI interface through dropdowns, filters, and license input fields: Risk and Opportunity Selection (riskMetric, opportunityMetric): Users select metrics for the X (Risk) and Y (Opportunity) axes. Dropdown Filters: These filters allow users to limit data to specific categories: Business Units Departments Investment Types Time Periods License Input Field: Enables premium features like data export and advanced interactivity when a valid license is entered. Quadrant Classification The visual places each data point in a quadrant based on its risk and opportunity values: Quadrant I (Top Right): High Risk and High Opportunity – Strategic but risky.
